assertions.query: SELECT v.MaVaiTro role,COUNT(*) n,COUNT(h.NguoiDungID) profiles FROM dbo.NGUOIDUNG u JOIN dbo.VAITRO v ON v.VaiTroID=u.VaiTroID LEFT JOIN dbo.HOSOKHACHHANG h ON h.NguoiDungID=u.NguoiDungID WHERE u.Email LIKE 'r82.staff.%@example.invalid' GROUP BY v.MaVaiTro;

SELECT TOP(1) p.RapID cinema,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.PHONGCHIEU r WHERE r.RapID=p.RapID AND r.TrangThai=N'Hoạt động') activeRooms,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.GHE g JOIN dbo.PHONGCHIEU r ON r.PhongID=g.PhongID WHERE r.RapID=p.RapID AND g.TrangThai=N'Hoạt động') activeSeats FROM dbo.PHANCONG_RAP p WHERE p.NguoiDungID=@ID AND p.TrangThai=N'Hiệu lực' ORDER BY p.RapID;
